temporal.description: Companies; positives restricted to awards before their SRI notification date

history.note: Initial marts (Signals v1 as first built). SUPPLIER_NOT_ACTIVE used the current SRI status with no time check (27,291 firings); GHOST_COMPANY_LIST fired on all 165 listed-supplier processes.

SUPPLIER_NOT_ACTIVE made time-aware (fires only if the suspension came before the process date): 27,291 -> 32 firings. All other signal counts unchanged. Harness gained variant C and leave-one-buyer-out.

Rule changes after review: SINGLE_BIDDER excludes Menor Cuantia goods/services cells (structurally single-tenderer): 74,964 -> 59,268; GHOST_COMPANY_LIST fires only for listings notified on or before the process date: 165 -> 6 (159 moved to the context signal GHOST_COMPANY_LISTED_LATER, weight 0); BUYER_CONCENTRATION requires that no single process reaches 30% of the buyer-year: 13,496 -> 3,231; CONTRACT_VS_COMPANY_SIZE uses the latest revenue year strictly before the award year: 4,023 -> 5,957 (same-year comparison kept as context signal, 614). Harness: reads only kind='risk' signals for scoring; both ghost codes excluded from held-out scores.

Registry-derived signals (ghost list, supplier not active, new supplier, contract vs company size) restricted to company and public-entity winners for data-protection reasons; found by manual inspection of a rendered process page.
